title: rotor-kv-allocator-interleaved-freelist-and-prefetch-hints
author: Asha Menon
description: Introduce the Rotor KV allocator and adaptive prefetch hinting to reduce contention on the paged KV block manager and improve throughput/latency for continuous batching workloads. Motivation: we observed bursts of allocation contention and repeated cold misses in the KV cache when many small requests arrived with similar prefix patterns; this amplified p99 token latency under realistic chat workloads. The change is two-fold: 1) a rotor-based interleaved freelist allocator that maintains multiple independent freelist lanes and rotates allocation targets per-request to avoid hot-sloting and cross-core contention; lanes are sized adaptively by observed occupancy and hotness windows. The allocator exposes a soft-pin API allowing callers to indicate short-lived retention to reduce churn during batched decoding. 2) a lightweight prefetch-hinting mechanism that records short-lived reuse signals at the prefix granularity and enqueues speculative prefetches when batching signals indicate an imminent reuse; hints are conservative by default and gated by an adaptive confidence threshold to avoid excess IO. Benchmarks: microbench harness shows 8-12% p99 tail reduction and 15-22% lower block churn for generation workloads with 1-8 token continuations; end-to-end continuous-batching traces show up to 10% increased throughput and a 7% reduction in billed token compute due to better KV reuse. The PR includes API compatibility shims for the existing pin APIs, unit + integration tests, and operational metrics (per-lane occupancy, prefetch hit/miss rates, adaptive-threshold value) for the Console. Backwards-compatible by default; feature gated by runtime flag and Canary rollout. Related: ENG-4227 (allocator redesign), ENG-4301 (batching prefetch work).

review_comments: Miguel Santos: Could you quantify the memory overhead for maintaining N lanes per allocator? Also suggest adding an eviction hysteresis when lanes shrink under pressure.
Asha Menon: Measured worst-case extra metadata is ~1.8% of active block memory for default 8 lanes; added comments and a lane-shrink hysteresis to avoid thrash (see rotor_allocator.go change).
Priya Kapoor: Prefetching looks promising but we need a safety valve in case prefetch queues grow under pathological input patterns.
Asha Menon: Added adaptive confidence gating and a bounded prefetch queue with LRU eviction; instrumentation added to alert when queue>80% capacity.
Liam O'Connor: Tests look good; please add a small canary manifest and docs for Console metrics so SREs can observe per-lane behavior.
Asha Menon: Added canary rollout notes and Console metrics doc (docs/perf/kv-prefetch.md).
ci_summary: All checks passed after two reruns. Unit tests: pass. Integration: pass. Bench/perf job: pass. Lint: pass. Flaky: one transient failure in kv allocator test on arm64 fixed by increased timeout.
release_notes:
- Rotor interleaved freelist allocator reduces KV allocation contention and improves tail latency
- Adaptive prefetch hints for continuous batching reduce cold KV misses and improve throughput
- New Console metrics: kv_allocator.lane_occupancy, kv_prefetch.hit_rate, kv_prefetch.queue_depth
notes_for_ops: Feature gated by runtime flag "kv.rotor.enabled"; Canary rollout recommended (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Watch kv_prefetch.hit_rate and lane_occupancy skew; alert if prefetch queue_depth > 80% for >5m.
benchmark_summary: Microbench: p50 unchanged, p95 -4% median, p99 -8 to -12% depending on traffic skew. End-to-end canary: throughput +6-10% for chat-like workloads, estimated token cost saving 5-9% in observed runs.
manual_test_steps: 1) Enable feature flag on a small canary fleet. 2) Run continuous-batching replay with representative prompt sets for 30 minutes. 3) Verify prefetch hit_rate > 60% and queue_depth stable. 4) Rollback by disabling flag if KV churn increases or p99 worsens.
related_work: See ENG-4227 design doc and perf notes in perf/rotor_bench.md; follow-up planned to add per-model lane tuning and integration with Optimize recommendations.
changelog_entry: rotor allocator + KV prefetch hints (opt-in); improved p99 for small-continuation workloads
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes are behind flag and include safety gates. Risk vector: excessive prefetch IO under adversarial inputs; mitigated by queue bounds and adaptive gating. Monitoring in place.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Add canary to release pipeline. 2) Observe metrics for 72h. 3) Work with Optimize to expose lane tuning suggestions.
